parameters.name: dstIp
parameters.description: The destination IP address. This parameter is used to match the destination sink address of a job.

parameters.name: dstPort
parameters.description: The destination port. Use this parameter with dstIp.

parameters.name: ignoreJobSummary
parameters.description: Specifies whether to exclude the job summary from the response. If you exclude the summary, only deployment information is returned. This improves performance.

parameters.name: ignoreResourceSetting
parameters.description: Specifies whether to exclude resource configuration information. This reduces the size of the returned data.

parameters.name: srcIp
parameters.description: The source IP address. This parameter is used to match the input source address of a job.

parameters.name: srcPort
parameters.description: The source port. Use this parameter with srcIp for an exact match of the connection.
